mapper.sql: SELECT d.dish_id, d.dish_name, d.category_id, d.merchant_id, c.category_name, d.image, d.price, d.stock, d.sales, d.status, d.description, d.remark, d.create_by, d.create_time, d.update_by, d.update_time FROM takeout_dish d LEFT JOIN takeout_dish_category c ON d.category_id = c.category_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO takeout_dish (dish_name, category_id, merchant_id, image, price, stock, sales, status, description, remark, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{dishName}, #{categoryId}, #{merchantId}, #{image}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{sales}, #{status}, #{description}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE takeout_dish SET status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE dish_id = #{dishId}
UPDATE takeout_dish SET stock = GREATEST(0, stock + #{stock}), update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE dish_id = #{dishId}
UPDATE takeout_dish SET sales = sales + #{delta}, update_time = NOW() WHERE dish_id = #{dishId}
UPDATE takeout_dish SET sales = GREATEST(0, sales - #{delta}), update_time = NOW() WHERE dish_id = #{dishId}
mapper.select: WHERE d.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND d.status = '1' ORDER BY d.sales DESC, d.dish_id ASC
